为什么 SQLite，而不是只用内存或偏好设置？: Why SQLite rather than memory or preferences?
我需要把结果和队列原子提交，还要有条件更新、唯一身份和迁移。内存不能跨进程；多份: I need atomic result-and-queue writes, conditional updates, unique identities and migrations. Memory cannot survive a process. Multiple key-value records need extra consistency logic. Drift could work too; hand-written SQL was more direct for this slice.
Future 超时就取消了网络吗？: Does a Future timeout cancel the network request?
不会。Future.timeout 只结束等待，底层请求可能继续；当前逻辑不让迟: No. Future.timeout ends the wait, while the underlying request may continue. Current logic prevents late results from reaching ACK commit. A real HTTP Transport must also handle cancellation/timeouts and server idempotency.
服务器收到结果，客户端来不及保存 ACK 呢？: What if the server receives the result before the client persists its ACK?
保留原 outbox，下一进程用原 operationId 重试。服务端需要按操: Keep the original outbox and retry with the same operationId in the next process. The server must handle that identity idempotently; the client alone cannot guarantee end-to-end exactly-once delivery.
ChangeNotifier 为什么够用，风险在哪里？: Why is ChangeNotifier sufficient, and where is the risk?
当前一个工作台；局部监听、不可变快照和构造注入简单。监听与 dispose 要显: One workbench makes local listeners, immutable snapshots and constructor injection simple. Listeners and dispose are explicit. A larger async dependency graph becomes harder to maintain; then I would reassess Riverpod/Cubit.

先在真实工作负载下 profile 查询、排序、聚合、build/raster: Profile queries, sorting, clustering, build/raster and memory on realistic workloads first. Add indexes, incremental queries, viewport markers and on-demand lists. Move measured CPU work to an isolate; do not claim current performance without measuring it.

附件文件与结果元数据分开，定义上传状态、恢复、限额、清理和账号归属。结果协议增加: Separate attachment files from result metadata; define upload state, recovery, limits, cleanup and account ownership. Add server versions and conflict types to the protocol. Agree terminal-state and manual-resolution policies first.

Widget 是配置，State 保存界面会话，BuildContext 表示树: Widget is configuration; State holds the UI session; BuildContext identifies a position in the tree. build should have no I/O side effects. Stable Keys help identify elements; release controllers and subscriptions in dispose.
debug 不卡，能说明上线性能吗？: Does smooth debug behavior prove release performance?
不能。目标真机 profile 检查 UI/raster 慢帧、启动、内存与电池: No. Profile slow UI/raster frames, startup, memory and battery on target physical devices, then verify the release experience. At 60 Hz a frame is about 16.7 ms; higher refresh rates require their own budget.
